info.headline: Flooding is possible: Tidal Fal Estuary
info.description:
High tides and forecast weather conditions tomorrow morning may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible up to 1 hour either side of high tide on Saturday morning.
High water levels may cause flooding to quaysides, harbours, and low lying land, roads and car parks.
High tide at Falmouth on Saturday is at 07:30AM, with a forecast tide level of 2.3mAOD, which is around 0.2m above tide table levels. Times and heights of high tide will vary along the coast. Force 6 Southerly winds and offshore waves of around 1m are forecast over high tide.
Coastal conditions should ease for Saturday evening's high tide.
info.instruction:
Be prepared
You should: - go to Check for flooding for a map of the area and to monitor up-to-date local flood information – https://check-for-flooding.service.gov.uk/target-area/114WATFALEST1 - get ready to act on your personal flood plan if you have one - https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/personal-flood-plan - follow the guidance in 'What to do before or during a flood' - https://www.gov.uk/help-during-flood
You can also read more about what flood alerts are – https://www.gov.uk/guidance/flood-alerts-and-warnings-what-they-are-and-what-to-do#flood-alert
Stay up to date
To get the latest flood information, you can: - go to Check for flooding - monitor local weather, news and travel updates - call Floodline on 0345 988 1188, using quickdial code 211042
